Easy to learn, quick to play, fun for hours! ATTACK your opponents to steal their cards DEFEND against players who target you COLLECT enough cards to declare victory SURVIVE and be the last player standing! The game is played using cards and can be won in 2 different ways: by collecting cards (6 of your own suit, or 15 cards total) or by being the last player standing! Each turn starts by drawing cards. You may then 'burn' cards - this allows you to discard cards from your hand and draw half the number from the deck, meaning you can swap some of the cards you don't need for a chance of getting the ones you want! You can then attack - using your own suit (and up to 1 card of another suit) to target another player and try to reduce their cards. When a player runs out of cards, they are out!
